The wearer is in the customer area, several feet from the service counter and facing the menu/register area. A staff member appears behind the counter, generally oriented toward the customer side. The counter separates them, so equipment and storage behind it are neither within reach nor in the wearer’s path. No package is visible, and nothing suggests the wearer is an employee or inspector. The appropriate next action is therefore to place an order with the staff member.
